violations.text: Ice and beverage debris observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Staff informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
Staff were observed rinsing utensils after sanitizing. Inspector discussed proper procedures with staff. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Staff washed, rinsed, and sanitized all utensils. Options for storage discussed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026
